sentences.text: Both the registered owner as well as the claimants are in appeal.
3. In this case, the vehicle involved in the accident was not insured at the relevant point of time.
4. After arguing the matter for sometime, learned counsel on both sides submit that the appeals may be disposed of by modifying the award.

5. It is agreed by the claimants that they would be satisfied if the amount awarded by the Tribunal,
along with an additional sum of Rs.25,000/- is paid.
6. Learned counsel for the owner also accepts that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal may be enhanced by a sum of Rs.25,000/- and the said sum would be paid within a period of four weeks.

7. In view of consent of both the parties, the appeals are disposed of holding that the claimant in MFA No.1180/2019 would be entitled to a sum of Rs.3,02,669/- (2,77,669 + 25,000) and the claimant in MFA No.1181/2019 would be entitled to a sum of Rs.1,98,457/- (1,73,457 + 25,000).
8.

It is to be noted here that the owner deposited a certain amount and for payment of the balance,
four weeks time is granted.
